name: lich
description: a Lich (Fall from Heaven), an undead skeletal sorcerer: a bare skull with glowing green eye sockets under a deep purple hood, a tall spiked gold crown with a purple gem, gold shoulder plates, an exposed bone ribcage, a gold belt with a small skull buckle, long tattered purple-and-black robes with gold trim, a glowing green soul gem held up in his bony RIGHT hand, and a gnarled wooden staff topped with a green-eyed skull in his LEFT hand
hands: the skull-topped staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his bony right hand on the screen-left side holds up the glowing green soul gem

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; the skull snaps back toward the upper-right, the green eye glow flaring, torso jolts back, both arms jerk up (his right hand flung up and out to the left still clutching the glowing green soul gem; his left arm yanked up behind his back, the skull staff still in that hand and standing upright behind his head), the crown and the tattered robes jolting back
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent under the robes, the skull staff still held upright behind his head, the soul gem hand still raised beside his face

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the skull staff high, the soul gem hand drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward under the robes, torso slumps forward, the skull droops, the skull staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the skull end of the staff resting on the ground at the lower-left, the soul gem hand hanging, its glow fading
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the skull staff slips out of the hand, the soul gem drops, legs slide forward, the tattered robes flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the spiked crown still on the skull; the skull staff lies on the ground at the lower-left; the dim soul gem beside his hand; the tattered robes spread under him
death.6: bounce: the skull and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the tattered robes settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, the eye sockets dark, the skull staff on the ground beside him, the soul gem dull
